reason: The full paper proposes a graded preference objective and benchmark for person/limb-motion video captioning and evaluates three VLM backbones, including Qwen3-8B; it improves GPA 2.02–3.40 points over DPO and lowers weighted hallucination 21.3% on Qwen3-8B. This is task-quality post-training, not an inference-efficiency method; linked Qwen architecture lineage is only indirect, so retain as borderline pending a concrete technical connection.
title: Beyond Binary Preferences: Graded Preference Optimization for Limb-Motion Captioning
